subject: Kickoff: LDS clustering for telemetry streams
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the LDS clustering track. Our open-source release clusters time series by the linear dynamical systems that generate them — including learning the eigenvalues of the hidden dynamics — and runs fully locally as plain Python scripts. The product bet for graphs-retrieval: group customer telemetry streams by underlying dynamics, not surface shape, feeding anomaly detection and retrieval.

Milestones:
- Apr 24: reproduce the eigenvalue-learning experiments (experiment_learn_eig.py, e.g. true_eig=0.1,0.8 with hidden_dim=2) and the clustering experiments at hidden_state_dim=3, 100 systems.
- Jun 5: benchmark on a real telemetry sample — cluster purity target 0.8.
- Jul 17: pipeline handoff review.

Bao will cover staffing. Hyun is research lead. This one is CPU-cheap, so no compute drama for once.

Anders
